versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the resistance-training-equipment-buying-consultant skill.  
- Provides step-by-step, personalized guidance for choosing resistance training equipment based on user goals, space, experience, safety needs, and budget.
- Interviews users with structured, conversational questions covering equipment type, weight ranges, space, flooring, and safety requirements.
- Delivers clear, unbiased equipment specifications so users can make informed buying decisions without relying on sales advice.
- Brand-neutral recommendations ensure users can evaluate any product that fits their needs.
